Sales Performance Report

Revenue, product mix, regions, and sales channels

Author

Sales Analytics Project

Published

October 4, 2026

1 Executive summary

The dataset covers 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 and contains 30,000 sales rows. Total revenue is $10,857,310 across 30,000 orders, with an average order value of $361.91.

The leading category is Electronics ($5,848,123). The highest-revenue region is North, and Online is the larger sales channel by revenue.

7 Notes on interpretation

  • The included data is synthetic and represents a simulated retail business.
  • Every order_id is unique in this dataset; each row therefore represents one order. If the data changes to multiple line items per order, calculate order value by first summing line revenue per order.
  • Revenue is the sum of total_price; average order value is revenue divided by distinct orders.
  • This report reads data/sales_data.csv directly and does not require the SQLite database.
